'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Kyle Miller LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Miller]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Buddyfox.
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
